title: EEZ Cross-chain admission
description: Admission decisions, shared deadline timing and gas projection versus canonical receipt evidence.

panels.title: Admission estimate versus canonical postBatch
panels.description: Every candidate, including successful batches without a cut. Receipt gas includes refunds and the calldata floor; required gas sizes execution before refunds. Canonical receipt gas is for the complete postBatch. Missing values stay null. Selection limit is the effective count cap; snapshot is the finite candidate set. Admission stop reason is separate from later proof/preflight failure. Historical absent causes remain unknown.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time,canonical_l1_block,accepted,admission_gas::float8,canonical_receipt_gas::float8,admission_gas::float8/nullif(canonical_receipt_gas,0) AS estimate_receipt_ratio,coalesce(admission_stop_reason,'Unknown (legacy or incomplete)') AS admission_stop_reason,selection_limit::float8,selection_limit_reason,reason AS outcome_reason,deferred,full_projection_gas::float8,preflight_gas_used::float8,preflight_gas_required::float8,signed_gas_limit::float8,candidate_id,transaction_hash,chain_status,history,rebuild_of FROM eez_indexer.admission_candidates WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND (${candidate:sqlstring}='*' OR candidate_id=${candidate:sqlstring}) ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 2000

panels.title: Preparation, proof and delivery
panels.description: Preparation and proof share the exact target deadline. Finalization covers signing and observer preflight; preparation ends at the proof request. Delivery is relay acknowledgement, not canonical completion. Remaining time is measured immediately before dispatch. Proof predictions show the configured seed, covering measurements or upward-scaled measurements; missing historical predictions remain null. Selected is the finite snapshot; examined reaches source checks. Untouched or selection-filtered sources have aggregate counts and no invented gas estimate. Selection limit is the effective count cap; snapshot is the finite candidate set. Admission stop reason is separate from later proof/preflight failure. Historical absent causes remain unknown.

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.time,c.candidate_id,c.selected AS snapshot,c.selection_limit::float8,c.selection_limit_reason,(s.detail->>'examined_count')::bigint AS examined,(s.detail->>'not_examined_count')::bigint AS not_examined,(s.detail->>'selection_filtered_count')::bigint AS selection_filtered,c.accepted,c.preparation_ms,c.nominal_preparation_ms,(p.detail->>'proof_estimate_ms')::float8 AS proof_estimate_ms,p.detail->>'proof_estimate_basis' AS proof_estimate_basis,c.proof_ms,(p.detail->>'post_reserve_ms')::float8 AS post_reserve_ms,c.finalization_ms,c.delivery_ms,c.relay_acknowledged,c.dispatch_remaining_ms,coalesce(c.admission_stop_reason,'Unknown (legacy or incomplete)') AS admission_stop_reason,c.reason AS outcome_reason,c.history FROM eez_indexer.admission_candidates c LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT data->'detail' AS detail FROM eez_indexer.admission_events e WHERE e.candidate_id=c.candidate_id AND data->>'kind'='proof_requested' ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1) p ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT data->'detail' AS detail FROM eez_indexer.admission_events e WHERE e.candidate_id=c.candidate_id AND data->>'kind'='summary' ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1) s ON true WHERE $__timeFilter(c.time) AND (${candidate:sqlstring}='*' OR c.candidate_id=${candidate:sqlstring}) ORDER BY c.time DESC LIMIT 2000

panels.title: Gas estimates per source transaction
panels.description: Filter by candidate ID or source hash; Inspect → Data exports CSV. Source simulation gas is not an exact share of the canonical postBatch receipt. Source preflight and canonical source receipt gas refer to inbound L1 companions; outbound L2 receipt gas is not collected here. Accepted deltas may include revocation of earlier discounts at a shape boundary. No estimate recorded means selection did not reach a recorded gas estimate, or telemetry is incomplete. Source timing covers source checks through the gas estimate, excluding subsequent append/finalization/proof. Earlier records without this timing boundary remain null.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time,candidate_id,source_hash,direction,position,decision,gas_constraint,t.estimate_ms-t.start_ms AS source_checks_and_simulation_ms,source_simulation_gas::float8,l1_target_simulation_gas::float8,entry_count,l1_call_count,nested_result_count,entry_reserve_gas::float8,entry_pin_gas::float8,entry_discount::float8,calldata_gas::float8,companion_declared_gas::float8,companion_simulation_gas::float8,source_preflight_gas::float8,source_required_gas::float8,canonical_source_receipt_gas::float8,projected_before::float8,projected_after::float8,accepted_delta_gas::float8,postbatch_hash,canonical_l1_block,reason,history FROM eez_indexer.admission_sources s LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT min((data->>'elapsed_ms')::float8) FILTER (WHERE data->>'kind'='source_selected' AND data->'detail'->>'timing_basis'='source_checks') AS start_ms,max((data->>'elapsed_ms')::float8) FILTER (WHERE data->>'kind'='source_estimate') AS estimate_ms FROM eez_indexer.admission_events e WHERE e.candidate_id=s.candidate_id AND data->'detail'->>'source_hash'=s.source_hash) t ON true WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND (${candidate:sqlstring}='*' OR candidate_id=${candidate:sqlstring}) AND (${source:sqlstring}='*' OR source_hash=${source:sqlstring}) ORDER BY time DESC,candidate_id,position LIMIT 10000

panels.title: Projection accounting
panels.description: Shared base and adjustments are separated from the accepted source deltas. Compare accepted observations with the summary to identify missing records.

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.time,c.candidate_id,c.admission_gas::float8,sum(s.accepted_delta_gas)::float8 AS accepted_source_deltas,(c.admission_gas-sum(s.accepted_delta_gas))::float8 AS shared_base_and_adjustments,count(*) FILTER(WHERE s.decision='Accepted') AS accepted_observations,c.accepted,c.history FROM eez_indexer.admission_candidates c LEFT JOIN eez_indexer.admission_sources s USING(candidate_id) WHERE $__timeFilter(c.time) AND (${candidate:sqlstring}='*' OR c.candidate_id=${candidate:sqlstring}) GROUP BY c.time,c.candidate_id,c.admission_gas,c.accepted,c.history ORDER BY c.time DESC LIMIT 2000

panels.title: Candidate event timeline
panels.description: Raw observations retain failed/rebuilt candidate identity. Finished marks the final sequence; gaps are reported even after collector restart.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time,candidate_id,sequence,stage,elapsed_ms,detail FROM (SELECT to_timestamp((data->>'timestamp_ms')::bigint/1000.0) AS time,candidate_id,sequence,data->>'kind' AS stage,(data->>'elapsed_ms')::float8 AS elapsed_ms,(data->'detail')::text AS detail FROM eez_indexer.admission_events) e WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND (${candidate:sqlstring}='*' OR candidate_id=${candidate:sqlstring}) ORDER BY time DESC,candidate_id,sequence LIMIT 3000

panels.title: Posting estimate coverage
panels.description: Historical estimates are never reconstructed from receipt gas. Older producers and ordinary-only posting paths do not emit cross-chain admission candidates.

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.time,p.attempt_id,p.transaction_hash,p.canonical_l1_block,CASE WHEN a.candidate_id IS NULL AND link.data->'detail'->>'candidate_id' IS NOT NULL THEN 'Candidate records missing' WHEN a.candidate_id IS NULL THEN 'No candidate telemetry (older producer or ordinary posting)' WHEN a.admission_gas IS NULL THEN 'Candidate has no summary' ELSE 'Estimate recorded' END AS coverage,a.history FROM eez_indexer.posting_attempts p LEFT JOIN eez_indexer.admission_candidates a USING(attempt_id) LEFT JOIN eez_indexer.posting_events link ON link.attempt_id=p.attempt_id AND link.data->>'stage'='prepared' WHERE $__timeFilter(p.time) ORDER BY p.time DESC LIMIT 2000

panels.title: Collector status
panels.description: A stale check or an error means coverage may be incomplete. Quiet queues do not themselves indicate collector failure.

targets.rawSql: SELECT checked_at,error,extract(epoch FROM now()-checked_at)::float8 AS seconds_since_check,(SELECT max(imported_at) FROM eez_indexer.admission_events) AS last_admission_import FROM eez_indexer.posting_collection
